message.content: {"question":"A homogeneous solid cylinder of length l = 40 cm, radius r = 2 cm and a mass m = 2 Kg rotates in a horizontal plane around a vertical axis perpendicular to its axis in the middle point O as a result of an impulse J = 5 10⁻² Ns received perpendicular to an extreme. As a result of the friction the cylinder stops after traveling a lap. Calculate the initial angular speed ω₀ of the cylinder","options":{"A":"ω₀=0.37 s⁻¹","B":"ω₀=3.70 s⁻¹","C":"ω₀=0.07 s⁻¹","D":"ω₀=37.00 s⁻¹"},"correct":"A"}
